system.description:
A gun for hire in Mournas or any city with work for one: no loyalties, odd jobs, survival instincts.

  • Stubborn: when Grit activates, you recover 1d6 HP instead of standing at 1 HP.
    • 9th level: 2d6 HP.
  • Shadow Work: Advantage on checks to negotiate payment, find employers, and stay out of the law's sight in a city.
